credits_text: A film by Stefano Bellone and Anna Francesca Quinto. Written by Stefano Bellone and Anna Francesca Quinto. Starring Stefano Bellone, Dea Francesco and Giulia Pivetta. Produced by Stefano Bellone. Music by Antonino Caruso. Director of Photography: Stefano Bellone. Special makeup effects by Chiara Sciuto. Edited by Chiara Sciuto. Sound design and mix by Francesco Russo and Marco Mastrovito. Original music by Antonino Caruso. Directed by Stefano Bellone and Francesco Russo.
